name: @ppl/jit-armv6m-prototype
description: Whole-program TS prototype of the ARMv6-M JIT translation algorithm (docs/jit-armv6m.md) — same per-procedure translation logic as the envisioned on-demand JIT, run eagerly over an entire program instead of lazily per-CALL, so the translator itself can be iterated on and run/debugged on QEMU without the arena/eviction/compaction runtime.
